title: Fence can answer ok for a job the keeper has just cut
notes: The keeper cuts a job (timer giveUp sets over) while a renewal sent before the cut is in flight. The renewal then finds the row ours, and attempt() answers pending asks with until=sent+lease, even though the job is over. The put checks only the clock, so a put can start after the job was cut. It is bounded by one round trip, and the work context is cancelled, so the put probably fails. Not reproduced.
